mapper.sql: select r.record_id as recordId, r.enterprise_id as enterpriseId, r.product_id as productId, r.record_type as recordType, r.biz_type as bizType, r.qty as qty, r.before_qty as beforeQty, r.after_qty as afterQty, r.source_no as sourceNo, r.batch_no as batchNo, r.operator_id as operatorId, r.operator_name as operatorName, r.remark as remark, r.reverse_flag as reverseFlag, r.reverse_record_id as reverseRecordId, r.create_time as createTime, p.product_name as productName, p.product_code as productCode from t_stock_record r inner join t_product p on p.product_id = r.product_id
mapper.select: select product_id as productId, sum(qty) as totalQty from t_stock_record where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and record_type = '2' and reverse_flag = '0' and create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by product_id
mapper.insert: insert into t_stock_record (enterprise_id, product_id, record_type, biz_type, qty, before_qty, after_qty, source_no, batch_no, operator_id, operator_name, remark, reverse_flag, reverse_record_id, create_time) values (#{enterpriseId}, #{productId}, #{recordType}, #{bizType}, #{qty}, #{beforeQty}, #{afterQty}, #{sourceNo}, #{batchNo}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{remark}, ifnull(#{reverseFlag}, '0'), #{reverseRecordId}, sysdate())
